findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：Parker 稱在多數主要市場為市場領導者之一，對手數以百計，Diversified Industrial 主要對手含 Bosch Rexroth、Danfoss、Festo、SMC、Gates 等；沒有任何單一對手涵蓋全部產品線。10-K 未點名特定新進入者。
findings.excerpt: Although each of our segments has numerous competitors, given our market and product breadth, no single competitor competes with the Company with respect to all the products we manufacture and sell.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：全球、區域及在地競爭者可能造成降價壓力與毛利率或市占下滑；公司也提到因應措施（如漲價）可能衝擊市占。
findings.excerpt: Our operations are subject to competition from a wide variety of global, regional and local competitors, which could adversely affect our results of operations by creating downward pricing pressure and/or a decline in our margins or market shares.

findings.claim: 經查：搜尋未找到第三方對 PH 份額增減的量化資料，也無對手設計勝出（design win）公告或明確新進入者報導；僅有投資社群敘事主張電氣化可能削弱液壓／氣動長期需求（低權威來源，未讀原文）。
findings.source: WebSearch 4 次結果彙總（Simply Wall St 社群敘事）
